Recorded claim:
At revision 2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555, TB Tools found exact accessibility failure signatures on other comm-central pushes. This shows that those signatures occurred elsewhere, but it does not establish why the target job failed or whether the whole Try passed. For a new assessment, check that the matching push is independent and assess every failure in the target job. The result can differ when the source or failure set differs.

Provenance: 24e30ded70c2909340dcbb901022bde81bf695a16ba34e737afdaa4b654c2f77. Original evidence IDs: 8745ef515eada27ea184e2765e39e7775fddcfb1493ae552e92f04784b3a188a, ba2f480999e26b4e32e714536746423dbc0c66d6b130c8ab8e7e54349e52f2a6.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
Source references:
https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555
title: Recorded lesson: Treat matching CI signatures as evidence, not a verdict
